implemented_requirements.evidence: constants.py defines GRID_SIZE = 4 and renderer uses GRID_SIZE to draw the grid and cells.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Arrow keys move tiles (up, down, left, right)
implemented_requirements.evidence: main.py maps pygame.K_UP/DOWN/LEFT/RIGHT to directions and calls Game2048.move().

implemented_requirements.requirement: Tiles with the same number merge and double their value
implemented_requirements.evidence: game_logic.py::_slide_and_merge_row merges adjacent equal tiles and returns the merged value.

implemented_requirements.requirement: A new tile (2 or 4) appears in a random empty cell after each valid move
implemented_requirements.evidence: Game2048.move() calls self.add_random_tile() after updating the board.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Game ends when no moves are possible
implemented_requirements.evidence: Game2048.can_move() checks for empty cells or adjacent equal tiles; move() sets self.game_over when can_move() is False.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Current score is tracked and displayed
implemented_requirements.evidence: Game2048.score is updated in move() and Renderer._draw_score_panel renders it.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Highest tile reached is tracked and displayed
implemented_requirements.evidence: Game2048.highest_tile is updated after each move and Renderer._draw_score_panel shows it.
